# YouTube Thumbnail Downloader
 
> Free browser-based tool to download YouTube thumbnails (Max Resolution, HD, HQ, MQ, SD) with exact pixel dimensions from any public video URL, including YouTube Shorts. Also supports Vimeo, TikTok, Dailymotion, Facebook, X/Twitter, and Bilibili links. No sign-up, no watermark, no app required.
 
## Core features
- Detects platform automatically from a pasted URL
- Returns all available thumbnail resolutions per video, verified before display
- Shows exact width x height for each returned image
- Download All as ZIP when multiple versions are available
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers
 
## Supported platforms
- YouTube (including Shorts)
- Vimeo
- TikTok
- Dailymotion
- Facebook
- X/Twitter
- Bilibili
